component.name: Ring of Elysium Local Launcher
component.summary: Play Ring of Elysium on the community local server

description.p: A community launcher for Ring of Elysium, whose official servers closed in 2023. It sets up and runs the ROE-LIVE community local server and starts the game against it with one button.

ul.li: Downloads and updates the community server and everything it needs (Python, .NET)
Finds the game in your Steam libraries and checks it is the supported build
Runs the game through the Proton version of your choice
Every server match option, practice targets, your own player name and an experimental map selector
LAN play: host a session on one computer and join it from another
Themes, backgrounds, optional Discord Rich Presence, and self-updates

description.p: You need your own copy of Ring of Elysium from Steam. This is a community project, not affiliated with Tencent or Aurora Studio. No telemetry: see the privacy policy.

screenshot.caption: Play Locally: the game, Proton, server status and the PLAY button

description.p: Game folder fixes, a repair for "No module named pip" on Linux, the server stopping on time while the launcher is minimised, a game files check, player profiles, an option to block Tencent's crash reporter, a Report an Issue button and a Server Browser ping column.
LAN play over Hamachi and Radmin VPN with hosts by address, updates that also refresh the documents, and an automatic VirusTotal scan of every release.
Windows exe with version information and an MSVC build, third-party licence notices, build provenance attestations, privacy and security policies, and this metadata.
LAN play: host and join from the Server Browser, without SSH.
First release for Linux and Windows.
